frozen_snapshot: metadata.csv (cleaned, 22,259 tiles) + splits.yaml + normalization_stats.json, all under gcs_root. Gate (mu0/sigma0/G) being re-measured by the 3-seed Phase 0c baseline on this snapshot.

tile_counts.note: Source metadata had 22,296 (1,755 pos / 20,541 neg). Dropped 37 QC-flagged positives (28 empty-mask + 9 band>50%-zero) → 1,718 pos. Negatives all ARTS-sourced; positives tagged batch1/2/3. See gcs_root/dropped_tiles.json.

split_counts.note: Generated by scripts/create_splits.py (seed 42, spatial-block) off this snapshot; all four constraints pass on attempt 1.

data_team_test_set: gcs_root/TESTING/ holds a separate data-team test set (3,000 tiles: 349 pos / 2,651 neg, 22 regions). All tile_ids are also in the main metadata and all regions overlap train regions (spatially entangled). Final-lock decision (use as Test-Realistic vs. spatial-block test split) is OPEN — see docs/v1.0_rebaseline.md.

extra_channels.description: NONE in v1.0 — EXTRA/ is empty in the regenerated dataset. Phase 4 (EXTRA channel groups) is blocked until the data team appends the EXTRA stack per data/data.md §9.

data_quality_notes: QC pass (user, /mnt/outputs/inference/v21_qc): 1,757 positives all uint8/3-band/EPSG:3857/512²; labels valid {0,1}; 0 all-zero RGB tiles; only 9 with a band >50% zero (vs 335 in v2.0 — missing-band bug fixed).
28 empty-mask positives (positive class, 0 RTS pixels) — a label bug; dropped from training and flagged to the data team as relabel candidates (gcs_root/relabel_candidates.csv).
upgrade_path: On any dataset change: re-run create_splits + compute_normalization_stats, bump this version string and the one in normalization_stats.json, re-baseline the 3-seed gate. Stage frozen snapshots into gs://rts-mapping-v2/training/<version>/ (our bucket) so external rewrites cannot destroy reproducibility.
